pipeline_assets.sponsor_note: Novel anti-DKK1 (Wnt-pathway) mechanism in MSS CRC — first positive randomised MSS-CRC signal for DKK1 blockade. mechanism_landscape.drug_class: STING agonists / innate-immune modulators; CCR2 inhibitors (combination partners)
mechanism_landscape.key_resistance_mechanism: Mechanistic framing. MMR-deficient CRC (~6-8%) generates excess cytosolic dsDNA via unrestrained DNA excision, baseline-activating cGAS; cGAS expression positively correlates with prognosis in dMMR (not pMMR) CRC, and the dMMR+high-TMB phenotype is the cGAS-STING-engaged subset underlying dMMR/MSI-H ICB sensitivity (Type I IFN -> CCL5 recruitment as intermediary). MSS/pMMR CRC = highest STING-activation barrier and where STING-targeting faces the steepest hurdle. Radioresistance node: host STING-IFN-I activation recruits MDSCs via CCR2 after local ablative radiation (MC38 model), driving radioresistance/relapse; CCR2-blockade potentiates STING-agonist + radiotherapy. Double-edged-sword caveat: chronic deregulated STING signalling drives inflammation-mediated colorectal carcinogenesis (recurrent STING loss also documented in CRC) — avoid chronic/continuous STING-agonist activation modality in any CRC programme

unmet_needs: MSS / pMMR metastatic CRC IO-resistance — the largest single oncology unmet need by patient volume (~1.8M cases/year globally). Botensilimab+balstilimab (Agenus NCT05608044), TIGIT combinations, CCR8/Treg depletion, CEA-CD3 bispecifics represent leading strategies

RAS-mutated mCRC outside KRAS G12C — ~45% of mCRC; only ~3-4% G12C subset has approved targeted therapy. KRAS G12D (~13%) and pan-RAS strategies (daraxonrasib RMC-6236, MRTX1133, ASP3082, RMC-9805) entering Phase 3
Peritoneal carcinomatosis — ~25% of mCRC at progression; poor chemotherapy delivery, IO refractoriness, no approved targeted strategy. PIPAC and intraperitoneal IL-15 muteins exploratory
BRAF V600E mCRC beyond 1L — BREAKWATER achieves mOS 30 mo 1L but 2L+ post-BRAF triplet is largely empirical. ctDNA-guided BRAF rechallenge under investigation
Organ preservation in rectal cancer — dMMR rectal dostarlimab (100% cCR Cercek 2022) and NICHE-2 nivo+ipi (67% pCR) practice-changing in small dMMR subset; MSS organ-preservation strategies needed
Elderly / frail patients (PS ≥2, age ≥75) — ~40% of CRC patients are 70+; pivotal trials systematically under-enrol PS2 patients. SUNLIGHT FTD/TPI+bev tolerable in elderly subgroups
Brain metastases — rare (~3%) but increasing; most CRC-active agents lack CNS penetration. Standard SRS/surgery
Predictive biomarker for bevacizumab benefit — no validated biomarker; circulating angiogenic factor panels exploratory
Early-onset CRC (<50 yrs) — rising incidence (~12% of US CRC); distinct biology poorly characterised; dedicated cohorts within Phase 3 trials emerging
HER2-low mCRC — T-DXd activity in IHC1+ / IHC2+/ISH- mCRC unconfirmed; extrapolation from breast-cancer HER2-low not validated
